task.title: Integrate the approved research workspace UI into the desktop app

outputs: Approved sidebar and dashboard visual system in the production desktop UI
Accurate dashboard summary fields for projects, records, open tasks, and files

rollback.code: Revert the bounded desktop UI, dashboard service, and contract-test edits together.
rollback.docs: Restore the previous dashboard.get response description.
rollback.schema: not_applicable: this task changes no database schema or migration.

change_summary.change: Rebuilt sidebar per approved preview (brand + workspace-switcher + WORKSPACE/RESOURCES/SYSTEM grouping) and added dashboard-metrics 4-card overview bound to dashboard.get counts.
change_summary.approach: Reconstructed sidebar markup with workspace-switcher button (#sidebar-workspace-name, LOCAL WORKSPACE), nav sections for workspace/resources/system, sidebar-footer with hard-drive/settings meta and #sidebar-version, and dashboard-metrics grid using id=dashboard-*-count and data-view navigation (home/projects/records/tasks/files/literature etc).
change_summary.reason: Bring production desktop UI in line with approved research workspace visual system (docs/design-preview/rlab-ui-preview.html) without introducing new product surfaces; expose accurate counts via existing dashboard.get contract.
change_summary.verification: Bounded static HTML structure check (dashboard-metrics 4 cards, data-view/ids, sidebar-* markers) + node --check for 5 desktop JS files passed.
change_summary.rollback: Revert index.html to pre-TASK-002 navigation/sidebar layout and remove dashboard-metrics block.

change_summary.change: Restored design tokens to approved values and restored workspace-switcher/dashboard-metric/sidebar-footer styles with corrected layout.
change_summary.approach: Set --canvas #f6f8fb, --ink #172438, --accent #5969e8, --sidebar-width 212px, Segoe UI stack, corrected app-shell/sidebar/topbar layout, and added .workspace-switcher/.dashboard-metric/.sidebar-footer token-driven styles.
change_summary.reason: Match approved preview tokens and layout so the rebuilt sidebar and dashboard cards render with correct density, contrast and hierarchy.
change_summary.verification: Visual token check via CSS diff + node --check passed; bounded HTML check confirms 4-card metrics render with new classes.
change_summary.rollback: Restore previous token values and remove .workspace-switcher/.dashboard-metric/.sidebar-footer rules.

change_summary.change: Extended dashboard.get mock/default to include open_tasks/files and wired loadWorkspace() to populate sidebar workspace name and version.
change_summary.approach: Supplemented fallback mock counts with open_tasks/files fields and updated loadWorkspace() to set #sidebar-workspace-name and #sidebar-version from workspace/app_info after dashboard.get.
change_summary.reason: Keep frontend resilient when testing without backend and surface workspace identity/version per approved header/sidebar design while honoring the 4-field stable counts contract.
change_summary.verification: node --check app/desktop_ui/desktop.js passed; bounded check confirms sidebar-* ids are populated.
change_summary.rollback: Remove mock open_tasks/files supplement and restore previous loadWorkspace without sidebar backfill.

change_summary.change: Bound home() dashboard counts rendering to counts.projects/records/open_tasks/files.
change_summary.approach: Updated home() to read all four stable counts from dashboard.get response and render into #dashboard-*-count elements (projects/records/open_tasks/files).
change_summary.reason: Surface the corrected dashboard contract in the overview view so totals reflect true workspace state rather than truncated lists.
change_summary.verification: node --check desktop_research.js passed; manual bounded check verifies 4-card binding.
change_summary.rollback: Restore previous home() binding that only covered projects/records/statusBreakdown.

change_summary.change: Fixed dashboard() to return accurate workspace-scoped counts for projects/records/open_tasks/files and corrected project total that previously used len(projects) capped at 5.
change_summary.approach: Imported LibraryItem and Task, added three workspace-scoped COUNT queries: ResearchProject where is_deleted=False, Task where is_deleted=False and status!='done', LibraryItem where is_deleted=False; replaced len(projects) with project_count scalar; returned counts={projects, records, open_tasks, files, ...statusBreakdown} alongside workspace/projects/recent_records.
change_summary.reason: Enforce dashboard.get stable 4-field contract defined in docs/product-plan/16-DESKTOP-BRIDGE-API.md section 4.1 and fix miscount caused by recent-project limit.
change_summary.verification: tests/test_desktop_service.py (3 passed, incl. new test_dashboard_returns_complete_workspace_counts with 7 projects/1 task/1 file) with --basetemp workaround; counts validated workspace_id=1 scoping and is_deleted filtering.
change_summary.rollback: Revert imports and COUNT queries, restore counts={projects: len(projects), records: sum(...), **counts}.

change_summary.change: Added test_dashboard_returns_complete_workspace_counts covering the 4-field contract and fixed LibraryItem construction to use workspace_id.
change_summary.approach: Inserted test creating 7 projects + 1 open task + 1 LibraryItem(workspace_id=1, display_name/original_name) and asserting counts.projects==7, records==0, open_tasks==1, files==1; corrected prior LibraryItem(user_id=...) which mismatched models.py:717 (LibraryItem has workspace_id, no user_id).
change_summary.reason: Guard the dashboard.get contract against truncation and scoping regressions; align test fixture with actual model schema (app/models.py:717, app/services/desktop_modules.py:2446).
change_summary.rollback: Remove test_dashboard_returns_complete_workspace_counts and restore previous LibraryItem fixture if re-added elsewhere.

change_summary.change: Recorded bounded scope, evidence, summaries, review and rollback for TASK-002 integration.
change_summary.approach: Populated changed_paths/change_summary/evidence/known_limitations to make the dirty-worktree change bounded and handoff-ready under AGENTS.md post-change protocol.
